LanguageData.PhobosTreatment_GizmoDesc: Pass the tank's untreated water through the reverse-osmosis membrane, {RATE} litres an hour, until all of it is clean to drink. {REJECT} of what passes runs off as reject, so the tank ends with less than it held. It draws {WATTS} W while it works: from the vehicle's own electrics, from the grid where a trailer stands, or from the lead of the vehicle towing it. Switch it off to keep the battery for starting.
LanguageData.PhobosTreatment_StateWorking: {LITRES} litres still to treat, at {RATE} litres an hour. Membrane: {MEMBRANE} left.
LanguageData.PhobosTreatment_StateClean: The water in the tank is clean. Membrane: {MEMBRANE} left.
LanguageData.PhobosTreatment_StateSpent: The membrane is spent: a mechanic must fit a new membrane cartridge before the kit works again.
